slot_contract.width_share: live content owns the primary reading field
slot_contract.target_aspect_ratio: landscape media slots retain the frame crop; code surfaces remain fluid
slot_contract.fold_requirement: primary message and action remain visible together at the primary laptop viewport

frames.dominance: typography and information hierarchy lead the quiet section
quiet_zones: preserve the open field around the headline and between content groups
frames.tension: Asymmetry and measured-line alignment distinguish the quiet policy/editorial document composition; do not flatten it into equal cards.
frames.image_copy_relation: live editorial copy owns the composition; measured rules organize rather than decorate

seam_contract: motif terminates or hands off cleanly at the section boundary
assembly.responsive_contract: recompose into an intentional mobile stack while retaining the same focal hierarchy and crop; omit nonessential line extensions before crowding content

space_roles.internal_grouping: keep related text and actions tight
space_roles.quiet_space: protect open space that makes the focal group legible
space_roles.section_transition: entry and exit space may expand without splitting semantic groups

viewport_intent.desktop_composition: native landscape frame translated to a normal laptop viewport, not literal 864px section height
may_continue_below_fold: secondary evidence or lower action when necessary

invariants: preserve the quiet policy/editorial document composition
keep Privacy Policy as the primary focal message
keep measured green motif aligned to the composition rather than decorative
free: exact responsive font sizes and leading
mobile order where the same focal hierarchy remains clear
